40000309.author: पदार्थः
40000309.content: एतत् this matter, श्रुत्वा having heard, सूत: king's charioteer, राजानम् addressing king, रह:  in privacy, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said, ऋत्विग्भिः by officiating priests, उपदिष्ट: advised, अयम् this solution, पुरा ancient, वृत्त: happened, मया श्रुत: heard by me.

40000309.author: Translation
40000309.content: The charioteer tells the king in privacy that he has heard the advice given by the offciating priests.

40000310.author: पदार्थः
40000310.content: राजन् O King, भगवान् possessing divinity, सनत्कुमार: Sanatkumara, तव your, पुत्रागमं प्रति    about the birth of your sons, कथाम् story,  ऋषीणां सन्निधौ in the presence of sages, पूर्वम्   earlier, कथितवान् narrated.

40000310.author: Translation
40000310.content: "O king, the divine Sanatkumara had narrated a story about your posterity in the presence of sages.

40000311.author: पदार्थः
40000311.content: काश्यपस्य for Kasyapa, विभण्डक: इति named Vibhandaka, श्रुत: famous, पुत्र: अस्ति has a son, तस्य for him, ऋष्यशृङ्ग इति named Rsyasringa, ख्यात: wellknown, पुत्र: son भविष्यति will be born.

40000311.author: Translation
40000311.content: Kasyapa has a famous son named Vibhandaka. It was prophesied that he would have a son named Rsyasringa.

40000312.author: पदार्थः
40000312.content: वने in the forest, नित्यसंवृद्ध: grown up, सदा always, वनचर: a person moving in the forest, विप्रेन्द्र: foremost among brahmins, स: मुनि: that sage, नित्यम् always, पित्रनुवर्तनात्  by following his father, अन्यम् others, न जानाति will not know.

40000312.author: Translation
40000312.content: Grown up in the forest and always moving with his father, that sage knows none other than his father.

40000313.author: पदार्थः
40000313.content: राजन् O King, महात्मन: eminet one, लोकेषु in the worlds, प्रथितम् celebrated, सदा always, विप्रै: by brahmins, कथितम् described, ब्रह्मचर्यस्य of Brahmacharya (life of celebacy), द्वैविध्यम्  twofold, भविष्यति will happen.

40000313.author: Translation
40000313.content: O eminent king, sage Rsyasringa celebrated in the three worlds who practises a twofold brahmacharya life (life of celebacy) described by brahmins (as vratitva and prajapatya).

40000314.author: पदार्थः
40000314.content: अग्निम् firegod, यशस्विनम् enowned, पितरम् च his father also, शुश्रूषमाणस्य while attending, एवम् in this manner, वर्तमानस्य living, तस्य for him, काल: time, समभिवर्तत will be spent.

40000314.author: Translation
40000314.content: Worshipping the firegod and attending on his renowned father, he will spend a long time living in this manner (practising vratitva mode of brahmacharya).

40000315.author: पदार्थः
40000315.content: एतस्मिन्नेव काले at this time, अङ्गेषु in the country of Anga, प्रतापवान् mighty, महाबल:  possessing great strength, प्रथित: celebrated, रोमपाद: king Romapada, भविष्यति will be living.

40000315.author: Translation
40000315.content: At this time a powerful king Romapada, mighty and celebrated would be living in the country of Anga.

40000316.author: पदार्थः
40000316.content: तस्य that, राज्ञ: king, व्यतिक्रमात् violation of code of conduct, सुदारुणा सुघोरा dreadful, सर्वभूतभयावहा frightening all living beings, अनावृष्टि: drought, भविष्यति will set in.

40000316.author: Translation
40000316.content: Because of violation of code of conduct by the king, a terrible, dreadful drought frightening all living beings will set in the kingdom.

40000317.author: पदार्थः
40000317.content: अनावृष्ट्याम् when drought, वृत्तायाम् will be prevailing, राजा king, दु:खसमन्वित: filled with grief, श्रुतवृद्धान् men who grow old by learning, ब्राह्मणान् brahmins, समानीय summoning,  प्रवक्ष्यति will say.

40000317.author: Translation
40000317.content: With drought prevailing, the griefstricken king, would summon all those grown old with learning and tell them.

40000318.author: पदार्थः
40000318.content: भवन्त: all of you, श्रुतधर्माण: are conversant in duties (enjoined by scriptures), लोकचारित्रवेदिन: wellversed in the ways of the world, यथा in whichever manner, प्रायश्चित्तम् expiation, भवेत् happens, नियमम् religious observance, समादिशन्तु instruct.

40000318.author: Translation
40000318.content: You all, conversant with the scriptural duties and well-versed in the ways of the world, instruct me in the religious observance by which expiation may be made.

40000319.author: पदार्थः
40000319.content: वेदपारगा: those learned in vedas, ते ब्राह्मणा: those brahmins, महीपालम् addressing the king, वक्ष्यन्ति will say, राजन् O king, विभण्डकसुतम् son of sage Vibhandaka, Rsyasringa, सर्वोपायै: by all means, इह here, आनय bring.

40000319.author: Translation
40000319.content: Those brahmins versed in the Vedas, said, to 'O king bring here Rsyasringa, son of the sage Vibhandaka by all means'.

40000320.author: पदार्थः
40000320.content: महीपाल O Monarch, सुसत्कृतम् greatly honoured, ऋश्यशृङ्गम् Rsyasringa, आनाय्य having brought, समाहित: with due reverence, कन्याम् your daughter, शान्ताम् Shanta, विधिना  according to religious ceremonies, प्रयच्छ offer.

40000320.author: Translation
40000320.content: "O monarch, on having brought Rsyasringa here, honour him, and offer him your daughter Santa with due reverence.

40000321.author: पदार्थः
40000321.content: तेषाम् their, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, राजा king, वीर्यवान् with controlled senses, सः   he, इह here, आनेतुम् to bring, केन उपायेन by what means, शक्य: capable of being done, चिन्ताम् contemplating, प्रपत्स्यते will obtain.

40000321.author: Translation
40000321.content: On hearing their words, the king in a thoughtful mood said, 'How can the mighty sage be brought here'?

40000322.author: पदार्थः
40000322.content: तत: thereafter, आत्मवान् intelligent, राजा king, मन्त्रिभि: सह in consultation with his ministers, विनिश्चित्य having decided, तत: thereafter, सत्कृतान् duly honouring, पुरोहितम्  priest, अमात्यांश्च counsellors, प्रेष्यति send on a mission.

40000322.author: Translation
40000322.content: Thereafter the confident king, having decided, in consultation with his ministers to bring him (Rsyasringa), sent the priest with the counsellors on this mission.

40000323.author: पदार्थः
40000323.content: ते they, राज्ञ: king's, वच: words, श्रुत्वा having heard, ऋषे: from the Rishi, भीता: frightened, व्यथिता: distressed, विनतानना: with faces bent down, न गच्छेम we will not go, तम् that, नृपम्  king, अनुनेष्यन्ति will appeal.

40000323.author: Translation
40000323.content: On hearing the king's words, distressed and frightened by rishi's power, they   appealed to the king, faces bent down, 'We will not go'.

40000324.author: पदार्थः
40000324.content: ते they, चिन्तयित्वा having thought about it, तत्क्षमान् useful in bringing him, उपायान् means, तस्य ते for that king, वक्ष्यन्ति will tell, वयम् we, विप्रम् that sage, आनेष्याम: will bring, दोष:  blame, न भविष्यति च will not accrue.

40000324.author: Translation
40000324.content: After thinking  about the means to be employed to bring the rishi to the court, they told him they would bring the sage if they are not to blame (in case anything untoward happens).

40000325.author: पदार्थः
40000325.content: एवम् in this way, अङ्गाधिपेन by the king of Anga region, Romapada, गणिकाभि: with the help of courtesans, ऋषे: सुत: son of sage Vibhandaka, आनीत: was brought, देव: god (Indra), अवर्षयत् poured rains, अस्मै for Rsyasringa, शान्ता Shanta, प्रदीयते च will be offered.

40000325.author: Translation
40000325.content: Thus with the help of courtesans of the king of Anga, when the son of the sage (Rsyasringa) was brought rains followed. The king offered his daughter Santa (in marriage to the sage).

40000326.author: पदार्थः
40000326.content: जामाता soninlaw, ऋश्यशृङ्गस्तु Rsyasringa, तव your, पुत्रान् sons, विधास्यति will ordain to be born, एतावत् till that instance, सनत्कुमारकथितम् the account communicated by Sanatkumara, मया by me, व्याहृतम् told to you.

40000326.author: Translation
40000326.content: 'Risyasringa, your soninlaw, would help you to obtain sons'. Thus said Sanathkumara which I have related to you.

40000327.author: पदार्थः
40000327.content: अथ now, हृष्ट: pleased, दशरथ: king Dasaratha, सुमन्त्रं प्रति addressing Sumantra, अभाषत spoke, ऋष्यशृङ्ग: Rsyasringa, यथा by whatever means, आनीत: was brought, त्वया by you, विस्तरेण in detail, उच्यताम् be described.

40000327.author: Translation
40000327.content: Thereupon Dasaratha, pleased, (with him), said to Sumantra, "Describe in detail the  means by which Rsyasringa was brought (to the court of Romapada)". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे नवमस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the ninth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana of the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
